title: A Theory-Guided Advanced Regulatory Control Synthesis for Cooling-Limited Exothermic Semi-Batch Reactors
summary: Cooling-limited exothermic semi-batch reactors require coordinated feed and cooling control to shorten batch time while maintaining the prescribed temperature. We develop a theoretical basis for advanced regulatory control (ARC) design by combining minimum-time and local safety analyses. Minimum-time analysis leads to an economic valve position control structure that adjusts feed using the temperature control system's cooling request, while cooling regulates temperature.
